guidance.statement: We hope to do 15% to 20% jewellery growth over a 3 to 5 year horizon on a CAGR basis.
guidance.quote: This is the medium to three to five-year horizon if you want to look at. This is the growth rate we are expecting.

analyst_concerns: Sustainability of jewellery buyer growth and preponement impact in FY27
Impact of rising gold prices and product mix on segment margins
Damas international losses and GCC market volatility
Competition intensity and discounting in jewellery
tone: Confident about long-term growth tailwinds, but cautious regarding gold price volatility and near-term margin pressures.
